water_crisis.title: The Silent Well
water_crisis.description: The water supply of Whispering Village has stopped. Find out why, and decide how to restore it.

guardian_trial.title: The Clockwork Guardian
guardian_trial.description: Mira's workshop hides a dormant clockwork guardian. Teach it, one lesson at a time, to protect the village.

start.title: The Silent Well
start.text: Dawn light creeps over Whispering Village. Buckets sit empty beside the well, and no one speaks above a murmur. Three trails lead out from the square.

dialogue.line: The water stopped three nights ago, traveler. Someone must learn why before the village loses hope.

record_choice.text: Went to inspect the broken waterwheel.
Went into the forest to find the spirit.

choices.label: Search the village cellars for another water source

record_choice.text: Searched the cellars for a hidden spring.

wheel_1.title: The Jammed Gears
wheel_1.text: The great wheel hangs motionless, its gears locked by a cracked axle pin. Mira is already here, sleeves rolled up.

dialogue.line: It's the pin. I can fix it properly, but it takes two pairs of hands and a lot of patience.

choices.label: Help Mira repair the gears piece by piece

mira.helped_repair: Player helped Mira repair the waterwheel gears.

record_choice.text: Carefully repaired the waterwheel with Mira.

mira.forced_wheel: Player forced the wheel and strained the old gears.

record_choice.text: Forced the waterwheel to turn.

wheel_2.title: The Last Gear
wheel_2.text: A trickle of water slips past the wheel. One gear remains to be seated before the channel to the village can open.

dialogue.line: One more gear and we're done.

alts.line: You were patient with the pin, so I trust you with the last gear. Seat it gently.
That shortcut cost us a gear. The last one has to be fitted carefully, understand?

choices.label: Install the new gear Mira built

mira.rebuilt_wheel: Player finished rebuilding the waterwheel with Mira.

record_choice.text: Restored the water with a rebuilt waterwheel.

choices.label: Patch it quickly and head back

mira.patched_wheel: Player left only a quick patch on the waterwheel.

record_choice.text: Patched the waterwheel; the water runs weakly.

spirit_1.title: The Heart of the Pines
spirit_1.text: Mist gathers between the pines. A soft light drifts toward you and settles into a shape like a deer made of dawn.

dialogue.line: Someone dammed my river's source with a thoughtless clatter. Why should I trust you?

choices.label: Apologise and offer a seed from the village

lumen.offered_seed: Player apologised and offered Lumen a village seed.

record_choice.text: Apologised to Lumen and offered a seed.
Demanded the water from Lumen.

spirit_2.title: A Fragile Bargain
spirit_2.text: The light dims, then steadies. Lumen waits for your next words.

alts.line: The seed was kind. Speak your promise, and I will listen.
You demanded. Now try asking. Speak your promise.

lumen.river_promise: Player promised to protect the river.

record_choice.text: Promised Lumen to protect the river; the water returned.

choices.label: Ask for just enough water to survive

lumen.small_ask: Player asked Lumen for only a little water.

record_choice.text: Asked Lumen for a small, steady flow.

underground_1.title: Beneath the Village
underground_1.text: In the oldest cellar, damp stone hints at water close below. Mira brings measuring rods and a lantern.

dialogue.line: If a spring sits under us, the rods will show it. Dig carefully or dig fast, your call.

mira.measured_spring: Player dug carefully using Mira's measurements.

record_choice.text: Dug carefully with Mira.

choices.label: Rally the villagers to dig fast

mira.dug_fast: Player rallied villagers to dig quickly.

record_choice.text: Rallied the villagers to dig fast.

underground_2.title: The Hidden Spring
underground_2.text: Cold water wells up through the stone, clear and strong. The village will not go thirsty after all.

alts.line: Exactly where the rods said. Careful work pays off.
Messy, but it worked! Next time, measure first.

choices.label: Channel the spring into the village well

mira.channeled_spring: Player channelled the hidden spring into the well.

record_choice.text: Channelled the hidden spring into the village well.

choices.label: Share the spring with the whole valley

mira.shared_spring: Player chose to share the spring with the valley.

record_choice.text: Shared the hidden spring with the whole valley.

village_epilogue.title: Water Returns to Whispering Village
village_epilogue.text: The village gathers at the well. Whatever you chose, the silence is over, and people are talking again.

dialogue.line: You gave us back our voices, traveler.

alts.line: That waterwheel runs better than ever. Thank you for helping me rebuild it.
The wheel holds for now, but we both know it needs real repairs.
I keep staring at that spring. Come see me, I have ideas for pumps.
Sharing the spring with the valley was generous. I'm drawing up plans for a canal.
I will hold you to your promise, river-keeper.
A small ask, quietly kept. I respect that.

record_choice.text: Followed Mira to her workshop.

guardian_intro.title: The Sleeping Guardian
guardian_intro.text: Behind the workshop door stands a tall figure of brass and oak: a clockwork guardian, perfectly still, with a keyhole in its chest. It was built to protect the village, but it only does exactly what it is told, in exactly the order it is told.

dialogue.line: Nobody has managed to wake it. Will you help me teach it?

alts.line: After the way you rebuilt that waterwheel, I think you can handle a guardian. Will you help me teach it?
You channelled that spring so neatly. A guardian should be no trouble. Will you help me teach it?
You shared the spring with the valley; I trust your judgement. Will you help me teach the guardian?

mira.offered_guardian_help: Player offered to help teach the clockwork guardian.

record_choice.text: Agreed to help Mira teach the clockwork guardian.

guardian_seq.title: A Lesson in Order
guardian_seq.text: Mira chalks a small room onto the workshop floor. The guardian stands at one side; a brass pedestal waits across the room, and a stone block stands in the way.

dialogue.line: It follows your instructions one at a time, exactly as given. No guessing.

mira.guardian_walked: Player guided the guardian across the room to the pedestal.

record_choice.text: Guided the clockwork guardian across the room.

guardian_seq_done.title: The Guardian Wakes
guardian_seq_done.text: Gears whir and the guardian turns its amber gaze on you. For the first time in years, it moves because someone told it how.

dialogue.line: Order matters. Swap two of those steps and it would have walked straight into the block.

choices.label: Lead the guardian to the cellar door

guardian_door.title: The Locked Cellar Door
guardian_door.text: Beneath the workshop lies the cellar where Mira keeps her spare parts. The door opens only for whoever carries the brass key. Sometimes the guardian has it, and sometimes it doesn't.

dialogue.line: Don't give it a single command. Give it a rule it can apply every time.

mira.taught_door_rule: Player taught the guardian a rule for the cellar door.

record_choice.text: Taught the guardian a rule for the cellar door.

guardian_door_done.title: A Guardian That Decides
guardian_door_done.text: The cellar door opens, and the guardian steps through as if it had always known how to choose.

dialogue.line: A rule that checks first and acts second. That is how a machine decides.

choices.label: Take the guardian to the river path

guardian_loop.title: Five Tiles to the River
guardian_loop.text: A narrow path of five identical tiles leads down to the river. The guardian's memory is small, and it can hold only two instructions at once.

dialogue.line: Writing the same step five times would never fit. Teach it to repeat.

mira.taught_loop: Player taught the guardian to repeat its steps.

record_choice.text: Taught the guardian to cross the river path by repeating a step.

guardian_epilogue.title: The Village Guardian
guardian_epilogue.text: By evening the clockwork guardian stands watch beside the well. It follows the rules you taught it: in order, by condition, and by repetition.

dialogue.line: The village sleeps easier tonight, and we owe it to you.
You did more than wake a machine. You taught it to think in steps. I'll never forget it.
